summary: Two Harbors Investment Corp., a mortgage REIT, filed an 8-K disclosing that CrossCountry Intermediate Holdco (CCM) and its merger sub irrevocably waived a merger agreement restriction to allow Two Harbors to declare a pro-rated stub dividend of up to $0.34/share upon closing of the proposed merger. The CCM Merger Agreement was signed March 27, 2026, and amended twice through May 7, 2026. The waiver permits a pro-rated quarterly dividend if the merger does not close on a quarter end. Two Harbors is the target in this pending acquisition by CCM. Watch for regulatory and shareholder approval timelines to gauge closing risk.
